component.name: Vigil
component.summary: Watch your PC for suspicious programs and connections

description.p: Vigil watches this computer in the background: which program talks to which address, what starts automatically, which files and packages look disguised or risky. Every finding explains itself, with the evidence, how sure Vigil is, and commands to check, fix and undo.
Nothing leaves your computer unless you switch it on. Vigil never runs a file it inspects.
First Vigil 2 preview: the daemon, the command line and the finding format.
